Argentino A]] |Indirect |} Note: Clubs with indirect affiliation with [[Asociación del Fútbol Argentino|AFA]] are relegated to the [[Torneo Argentino A]], while clubs directly affiliated face relegation to [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. Clubs with direct affiliation are all from [[Greater Buenos Aires]], with the exception of [[Club Atlético Newell's Old Boys|Newell's]], [[Club Atlético Rosario Central|Rosario Central]], [[Central Córdoba de Rosario|Central Córdoba]] and [[Argentino de Rosario]], all from [[Rosario]], and [[Unión de Santa Fe|Unión]] and [[Colón de Santa Fe|Colón]] from [[Santa Fe, Argentina|Santa Fe]]. The bottom two teams of this table face relegation regardless of their affiliation status. Apart from them, the bottom teams of each affiliation face promotion/relegation playoffs against [[Torneo Argentino A]] and [[Primera B Metropolitana]]'s "Reducido" (reduced tournaments) champions. The Reducidos are played after those leagues' champions are known. ==Relegation Playoff Legs== {{TwoLeg start}} |- !colspan="5"|Relegation/promotion playoff 1 (Direct affiliation vs. Primera B Metropolitana) {{TwoLegResult| '''[[Deportivo Merlo]]''' | | 2–0 | [[Club Atlético Los Andes|Los Andes]] | | 1–0 | 1–0 }} |- !colspan="5"|Relegation/promotion playoff 2 (Indirect affiliation vs. Torneo Argentino A) {{TwoLegResult| [[Patronato de Paraná|Patronato]] | | 1–5 | '''[[Comisión de Actividades Infantiles|CAI]]''' | | 0–2 | 1–3 }} |- |} * Deportivo Merlo was promoted to [[2009–10 Primera B Nacional]] by winning the playoff and Los Andes was relegated to the [[2009–10 Primera B Metropolitana]]. * CAI remained in the [[Primera B Nacional]] by winning the playoff. ==Season statistics== ===Top scorers=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" |- !Rank !Player !Club !Goals |- |1 |align="left"|{{flagicon|ARG}} [[Luis Miguel Rodríguez (footballer)|Luis Rodriguez]] |align="left"|Atlético Tucumán |20 |- |2 |align="left"|{{flagicon|ARG}} [[Luis Salmerón]] |align="left"|Talleres (C) |18 |- |rowspan="3"|3 |align="left"|{{flagicon|ARG}} [[Emanuel Gigliotti]] |align="left"|All Boys |rowspan="3"|16 |- |align="left"|{{flagicon|ARG}} [[Javier Toledo]] |align="left"|Chacarita Juniors |- |align="left"|{{flagicon|ARG}} [[Juan José Morales]] |align="left"|Quilmes |- |rowspan="3"|6 |align="left"|{{flagicon|ARG}} [[Matías Alustiza]] |align="left"|Chacarita Juniors |rowspan="2"|14 |- |align="left"|{{flagicon|ARG}} [[Javier Rossi]] |align="left"|Tiro Federal |} ==See also== *[[2008–09 in Argentine football]] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *{{cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/arg2-09.html|title=Argentina Second Level 2008/09|website=[[RSSSF]]|accessdate=2014-05-19}} {{Primera B Nacional |state=collapsed}} {{DEFAULTSORT:2008-09 Primera B Nacional}} [[Category:2008–09 in Argentine football]] [[Category:Primera B Nacional seasons]]
